en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small European town surrounded by fields and forest. The foreground shows cultivated farmland bordered by a line of tall deciduous trees. Behind the fields lies a compact settlement of detached houses, mostly wooden or stuccoed buildings with gabled roofs, some painted light colors. There is a slightly larger central building complex that might be a church, school, or community hall. The town is embedded in a heavily forested landscape, with straight rural roads and scattered farm structures. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
